positions.title: Student Catering Manager
positions.description:
-Oversee a team of 2 to 12 servers to provide the best banquet experience for our guests
-Responsible for accommodating all guests at a function while circulating the room
-Anticipating the needs of the guests and responding politely to their needs accordingly

positions.title: IT Developer Intern
positions.description: -Worked on company’s legacy web application and converted it from Silverlight to C# and embedded SQL. The tool identifies and tracks errors with customers’ orders. It is designed to automatically fix the errors or allow end users to manage the errors.

positions.title: Student Caller
positions.description:
-Served as representative of the Iowa State University
-Conducted courteous, professional and punctual calls to alumni and parents asking for money contribution to support Iowa State University scholarships and programs
-Raised approximately $10,000 for Iowa State University
